title: THE HOST IS TOLD WHEN A TEAMMATE IS OUT OF THE RAID
why: When the host leaves, the teammate reads the host is out of this raid and how. The other way round the host was told nothing: his teammate just vanished from the screen. A teammate whose raid ended is now named in the raid with how it ended: killed, extracted or abandoned.
now: When your teammate is out of the raid (killed, extracted or abandoned), you are told by name.
